## 1. Primary Empirical Data Sources

The empirical framework and macro panel metrics draw upon data from federal statistical agencies and historical economic repositories. Below are the formal APA 7th Edition reference citations for each dataset:

### U.S. Gross Domestic Product (GDP) Data

- **Reference List Citation**:
  > Macrotrends. (n.d.). *U.S. gross domestic product 1960–2026*. Retrieved July 30, 2026, from [https://www.macrotrends.net/datasets/global-metrics/countries/usa/united-states/gdp-gross-domestic-product](https://www.macrotrends.net/datasets/global-metrics/countries/usa/united-states/gdp-gross-domestic-product)

---

### U.S. Census Bureau (Table A-2: Household Median Income)

- **Reference List Citation**:

## 2. State Higher Education Investment Metric

The state higher education investment variable (`edu_investment_pct`) is a **synthetically modeled panel metric** generated via the project's data generation script (`R/generate_data.R`). It models annual state higher education appropriations and research investment growth rates centered around macro GDP expansion ($2.0\% + 0.3 \times \Delta \text{GDP} + \varepsilon$).
